claim: **统计二分法：'根本统计'（fundamental statistics）看底层条件、能预测供需与货币状况并充当'贸易的气压表'；'比较统计'（comparative statistics）只量表面/过去条件，选安全证券可用、做短波判断则无用**：1912 年《Business barometers》第一章写 `STATISTICS are divided into two classes, viz. : Comparative Statistics and Fundamental Statistics`（统计分两类）并界定 `Fundamental statistics relate to underlying conditions of the country and make it possible to forecast demand, supply, money conditions, etc.`（根本统计涉及全国底层条件、使之能预测需求、供给与货币状况）；1913 年《Bonds and stocks》序言把'照管财产'与'投资科学'当被忽视的学问（`When it comes to the science of investins" money, very few people make it a question for thought and study.`，OCR 讹形 `investins"` 照录）；1910 年期刊《Barometric Indices》给出同一二分（`Statistics are divided into two classes`）并断言比较统计对判断大盘走向 'worthless'（改述）。　［出处：《Business barometers》1912（第 5 版）；《Bonds and stocks》1913；《Barometric Indices of the Condition of Trade》1910（JSTOR）］

claim: **战争有真实的经济原因、须消除原因而非'筑坝拦流'；和平要靠'国际事务的国际管控'与让利——'等量反应'法则的外推**：1916 年《A Business Man's View on How to Secure Permanent Peace》写 `war will be abolished only when some method is devised for enabling nations to obtain peaceably what they would otherwise secure through an armed conflict`（只有当设计出办法让各国和平取得它们否则要靠武装冲突取得的东西时，战争才会被废除）与 `there are real economic causes of war which must be eliminated before there can be world peace`（在世界和平之前必须先消除战争的真实经济原因）、`"International Control of International Affairs."`（国际事务的国际管控——商人圈的口号），并以 `we as nations, classes, and individuals, can permanently prosper only as we co-operate in some plan which enables others to prosper with us`（各国、各阶级与各个人只有在让旁人随之繁荣的合作计划中才能持久繁荣）收束；1920 年《A Constructive Policy for Mexico》把同一'等量反应/自救'用于发展观：`It seems to be a law of nature that nations and individuals must work out their own salvation and find themselves through struggle and sacrifice.`（民族与个人只能靠挣扎与牺牲自救，似乎是自然法则）。　［出处：《A Business Man's View on How to Secure Permanent Peace》1916（JSTOR）；《A Constructive Policy for Mexico》1920（JSTOR）］

claim: **一个指认得出的盲区：他承认'作用与反作用相等，但反作用由什么构成没有已知法则'，却把整套 barometer 预测体系建在这条'内容空洞'的守恒律上——形式守恒、构成未知，预测的锚点其实未定**：1912 年《Business barometers》写 `Action and reaction are equal; but of what "reaction" consists, there is no known law`（作用与反作用相等；但'反作用'由什么构成没有已知法则），随即又用 `Time, then, may be compared to space, and activity may be compared to weight, and their product to space multiplied by weight or to "foot-pounds."`（时间比空间、活动比重量、乘积比英尺磅）给'面积'一个可操作定义；1910 年《Barometric Indices》承认单一指标会失败（金流动在 1906-07 反而先于 1907 恐慌出现，`No one of these subjects, when studied independently, serves to foretell the great changes in conditions which have occurred since i860`），却仍假设'多数指标合流'必然预告转向——'多数可信'本身没有被证明。　［出处：《Business barometers》1912（第 5 版）；《Barometric Indices of the Condition of Trade》1910（JSTOR）］
contexts: 被问他的预测体系凭什么成立

evidence_clusters: 教科书自白：反作用构成无已知法则（形式守恒、内容未定）

falsifiers: 若证明他给出了'反作用构成'的操作性内容（如某组具体指标权重）⇒ 本条收窄为'其理论自白层的内容空洞'；语料内只见面积定义、未见构成理论
